text.en: Clients consistently praise the quality and precision of the grooming results delivered at Groom47. Reviewers note that dogs leave with evenly shaped facial styling, tidy coats, and a long-lasting clean scent. Owners of breeds ranging from Labradoodles to smaller companions express great satisfaction with how fresh their pets look.

Dog owners speak very warmly of Stephanie’s friendly communication and accommodating service. Reviewers note that she listens carefully to specific styling preferences and handles drop-offs with reassurance, creating a welcoming and calm atmosphere that encourages long-term repeat visits from local pet families.

Several reviewers highlight the gentle and reassuring care shown towards nervous or first-time pets. Owners mention that young puppies and timid dogs are handled with genuine fondness and patience, allowing them to relax during the grooming session without feeling overwhelmed or anxious.

q.en: Are nervous dogs comfortable during grooming sessions?

a.en: Reviewers mention that Stephanie is patient and reassuring with nervous dogs and puppies, helping them settle in calmly.

q.en: Can specific styling requests be accommodated?

a.en: Yes, clients note that facial trims and coat shapes are carried out neatly according to individual owner instructions.

q.en: Is this salon suitable for regular maintenance grooming?

a.en: Multiple pet parents report visiting every few weeks or over several years for ongoing deshedding, clipping, and bathing.
